message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && git show HEAD~1:src/hb-ot-cff1-table.hh | grep -n "fini\|fontDicts\|privateDicts\|fini_deep" | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `length_at` function in the vulnerable version doesn't check if `offset_at(index+1) >= offset_at(index)`. If the offsets are malformed (e.g., offset_at(index+1) < offset_at(index)), the subtraction wraps around, producing a huge length. This can lead to out-of-bounds reads and potentially double-free issues.

But the crash description says "Heap-double-free" in `hb_vector_t<CFF::op_str_t, 8u>::fini`. Let me look more carefully at the CFF1 accelerator init to understand the double-free path:
